standard.summary: 当前后端实现为 lora_delta：约束负面提示词下
standard.whenToUse: 不确定时先保持默认，小步数短测后再调。
standard.avoidWhen: 与预检冲突或与其它互斥选项同时开启时。

optionDescriptions.lora_delta: 压一压负面提示下的 LoRA 增量，少把不该出现的负面语义学进去。

standard_en.summary: The backend currently implements lora_delta: it constrains what happens under the negative prompt
standard_en.whenToUse: When unsure keep the default; run a short low-step test before changing it.
standard_en.avoidWhen: When it conflicts with preflight, or when a mutually exclusive option is enabled at the same time.

optionDescriptions.lora_delta: Holds down the LoRA increment under a negative prompt, so less of the semantics you do not want gets learned.

advanced.principle: 当前后端实现为 lora_delta：约束负面提示词下 LoRA 开启与关闭的预测差异。

advanced_en.principle: The current backend implements lora_delta: constraining the prediction difference between LoRA on and off under the negative prompt.
